answer: An agent economy resists sybils with fault-diagnosis diversity: each epoch, every identity gets a unique, corrupted task and must diagnose the fault in its own words. Like yarrow, genuine diagnoses grow differently in each soil, while a farm's fakes, run by one model, submit the same fix and are flagged together. The trellis of peer review checks each diagnosis against the real fault, so the signal of a copied answer exposes the cluster. One operator cannot write a thousand distinct, correct diagnoses in one window; each fake pays full reasoning cost while an honest agent pays once.
